ModMetaData.name: Vanilla UI+ Main Bar
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Customizes RimWorld's bottom main menu bar while staying close to the vanilla look.
Reorder tabs, move them into a More menu, hide them, change icons, and choose icon-only / text-and-icon / text-only. Hidden tabs and tabs in More keep their hotkeys.
Works on its own or alongside Vanilla UI+. If you used these options in an older Vanilla UI+, your layout is copied once from the old config.
Change options under Options → Mod options → Vanilla UI+ Main Bar.
